set_aside.subject: backup snapshot instant
set_aside.text: “a backup's instant is the one `store` reads when the copy's read transaction begins” contradicts “the instant of the read that fixed its snapshot” and “the snapshot fixed by its first read, of the audit counter, with the clock read then”
set_aside.question: Does the backup record the clock instant when its read transaction begins, or when its first read fixes the snapshot?
options: Record the instant when the read transaction begins.
Record the instant when the first audit-counter read fixes the snapshot.
set_aside.default_guess: Record the instant when the first audit-counter read fixes the snapshot, following the changed passages.

witness.initial: A WAL-mode store has audit counter 10; a backup connection begins a deferred read transaction but has not read from it.
events: A Registry action commits a transaction that advances the audit counter to 11.
The backup performs its first read of the audit counter and thereby fixes its snapshot.
outcomes: The unchanged Time passage records the earlier instant when the read transaction began, while the copied store contains audit counter 11.
The changed store passage records the later instant of the first read that fixed the snapshot, while the copied store contains audit counter 11.
witness.observer: The owner reading the backup instant, and any restore or retention tooling using that metadata, sees the difference.
